WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id FROM video_files vf
  WHERE channel_topic = '╨╛╨▒╤Г╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡_╤В╨╛╤А╨│╨╛╨▓╨╗╨╡_╨╜╨░_╤А╤Л╨╜╨║╨░╤Е'
    AND status = 'pending'
    AND COALESCE(file_content, '') <> ''
    AND file_content NOT IN ('╨Э╨╡╤В ╤А╨╡╤З╨╕ ╨▓ ╨▓╨╕╨┤╨╡╨╛', '╨Т╨╕╨┤╨╡╨╛ ╨▒╨╛╨╗╤М╤И╨╡ 1 ╤З')
    AND file_content NOT LIKE 'Colab: skipped_too_long%'
    AND length(file_content) >= 300
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pending_review pr
      WHERE pr.video_id = vf.video_id AND pr.status IN ('pending', 'rejected')
    )
  ORDER BY id ASC
  LIMIT 5
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE video_files vf
  SET status = 'processing'
  WHERE vf.id IN (SELECT id FROM picked)
  RETURNING vf.id, vf.video_id, vf.channel_name, vf.video_url, vf.file_name, vf.file_content
)
SELECT u.id, u.video_id, u.channel_name, u.video_url, u.file_name, u.file_content,
       v.published_at
FROM upd u
LEFT JOIN videos v ON v.video_id = u.video_id
ORDER BY u.id ASC;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO pending_review (video_id, channel_name, video_url, file_name, file_content, part, chapter, status)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'pending')
  ON CONFLICT (video_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING video_id, channel_name, video_url, file_name, part, chapter
)
SELECT video_id, channel_name, video_url, file_name, part, chapter, true AS inserted FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT video_id, channel_name, video_url, file_name, part, chapter, false AS inserted FROM pending_review
WHERE video_id = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
LIMIT 1;
UPDATE video_files SET status='review', is_processed=false WHERE video_id=$1;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS video_id,
    $2::text AS video_url,
    $3::text AS file_name,
    $4::text AS channel_name,
    $5::text AS error_message
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO video_errors (video_id, video_url, title, channel_name, channel_topic, error_message, status, level, category, source, resolved)
  SELECT video_id, video_url, file_name, channel_name, '╨╛╨▒╤Г╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡_╤В╨╛╤А╨│╨╛╨▓╨╗╨╡_╨╜╨░_╤А╤Л╨╜╨║╨░╤Е', error_message, 'error', 'ERROR', 'write', 'n8n', false
  FROM input
  RETURNING video_id
)
UPDATE video_files vf
SET status = CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(vf.attempts, 0) + 1 < 3 THEN 'pending'
    ELSE 'error'
  END,
  attempts = COALESCE(vf.attempts, 0) + 1,
  is_processed = false,
  last_error = (SELECT error_message FROM input)
WHERE vf.video_id = (SELECT video_id FROM input)
RETURNING vf.video_id, vf.status;

UPDATE video_files
SET status = CASE
  WHEN $2 = true THEN 'done'
  WHEN COALESCE(attempts, 0) + 1 < 3 THEN 'pending'
  ELSE 'error'
END,
attempts = COALESCE(attempts, 0) + CASE WHEN $2 = true THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
is_processed = CASE WHEN $2 = true THEN true ELSE false END,
last_error = CASE WHEN $2 = true THEN NULL ELSE $3 END
WHERE video_id = $1
RETURNING video_id, status;
